text.en:
Today you use everything you learned.
Is the small room still available?
I have already sent you the receipt.
Some sentences ask.
Some say what has happened.

Look at when it was.
Now, before, or maybe later?
If the bus is full, we will walk.
She said she could meet us after lunch.
Each small word has its job.
Pick the one that fits.

You will mix questions, the past, if and more.
Was the deposit included in the total?
That is the hotel where I left my charger.
Read the sentence first.
Then choose the word.
You know this now.
